newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Premier says revaluation boosts profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Premier says revaluation boosts profit.

text.p: Premier Investments Ltd said on Tuesday a A$16.9 million upward revaluation to market value of its listed investments helped its annual profit soar 166 percent.
Premier gave no details of the revalued investments.
The investment company, which is contolled by Coles Myer Ltd deputy chairman Solomon Lew, posted a net profit after abnormals for the year to June 30 of A$24.5 million.
The company's housewares group saw pre-tax profits grow to A$7.16 million despite very difficult trading conditions, Premier said in a statement.
Group profits also were augmented by a special dividend distribution of A$4.4 milion from the CapGuard Securities CML December 1998 Trust.
The directors reaffirmed their policy that no dividend would be paid until prior year losses were recouped.
